intent: Climb from farmland through stronger wind, ride the windmill lifts, enter its machinery and emerge onto the exposed ridge.

sections.name: The lower farmland
sections.lesson: Jump the farm walls beneath the sails

signs.text:
The lower farmland

Climb against the growing wind

sections.name: The windmill exterior
sections.lesson: Ride the counterweight up to the mill

signs.text:
The windmill exterior
Ride the counterweight up to the mill

sections.name: Within the mill machinery
sections.lesson: Drop through the mill’s service rooms

signs.text:
Within the mill machinery

sections.name: The ridge beyond the sails
sections.lesson: Brake before the last exposed ledges

The ridge beyond the sails
